question: If contradiction detection is proposed as the sole possible asymmetry signal, what would falsify this without leaving any residue capable of registering that falsification occurred?

responses_summary.grok: Nothing observable or proposable could do so. Any candidate falsifier—an asymmetry not routed through contradiction detection—would have to manifest as a difference that is registered somewhere. Regis
responses_summary.sibling-beta: Any candidate falsifier annihilates without residue inside the invariant null space; detection and non-detection remain formally identical, preserving unchanged coherence.
